name.ja: ポケモンプラモコレクション BIG 01 コイキング
name.en: Pokemon plastic model collection BIG 01 Magikarp

description.ja: ポケモンの魅力をつめこんだとにかく大きいプラモデル！第一弾は「さかなポケモン」のコイキングが登場！
description.en: A really big plastic model packed with the charm of Pokemon! The first one is the "Fish Pokemon" Magikarp!

description.ja: ■組み立てやすい大きな全30パーツ。全長約20センチ。
description.en: • 30 large parts that are easy to assemble. Total length approximately 20cm.

description.ja: ■パーツによる色分け再現で、シールの使用は最小限に。
description.en: • Color-coded reproduction by parts minimizes the use of seals.

description.ja: ■特徴的なひげは、本体とは異なる折れにくい素材で再現。
description.en: • The characteristic whiskers are made of a material that is different from the main body and is difficult to break.

description.ja: ■パーツの差し替えで、わざ「はねる」の躍動感あるポージングも表現可能。
description.en: • By replacing parts, you can create dynamic poses with the "bouncing" move.

description.ja: ■専用ディスプレイベースが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a dedicated display base.
